changelog:
- Microsoft Bing Default Search: Integrated Bing with Copilot AI as default search engine across the native browser and start page, complete with quick switcher toolbar access and settings integration.
- Modern Bulky Curvy Command Card: Redesigned the address/search card into a sleek dark rounded capsule pill with high-contrast text, glowing cyan voice mic, round black-bordered tab counter, and pure white three-dots menu.
- Sleek Dark Circular Action Buttons: Redesigned Favorites, Images, Videos, and Save into dark circular icon discs with clean glowing vector icons.
- Authentic Brand Logos: Replaced basic/emoji-like search icons with crisp official vector SVGs for Bing, Google, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Brave, and Startpage.
